payload.title: [Figs. 6-8] Proximity Probability and Plume Distance
payload.summary: This notebook presents a framework to evaluate the probability of observing a climate trace within an ensemble of trajectories, focusing on the proximity and compatibility of different climate reconstructions and model simulations. It introduces a method to compute the proximity probability by measuring the q-norm distance between traces and ensemble members, and visualizes these probabilities as a function of a proximity threshold. The notebook also defines and explores the plume distance metric, which summarizes differences between ensembles. The analysis includes comparisons between PMIP3 simulations and LMRonline data, and evaluates the compatibility of LMRonline and LMRv2.1 ensembles.
goals: Assess the distance and compatibility of climate reconstructions.
Compare model simulations to reconstruction ensembles.
Define robust statistics of distance using proximity probability.
Evaluate the plume distance metric for ensemble comparisons.
